releases.notes:
# Changelog

## Main
- Renamed GlslFileEntry to GLSLFileEntry
- Renamed GlslContent to GLSLContent
- Renamed GlProgramSnippet to GLProgramSnippet
- Renamed GlProgram to GLProgram
- Renamed GlShader to GLShader
- Renamed GlProgramBuilder to GLProgramBuilder
- Renamed GlShaderBuilder to GLShaderBuilder
- Renamed SamplerObject to GLSampler
- Removed unbinding buffers and programs
- Added resource tracking (programs, shaders, textures, framebuffers, samplers, vertexArrays)
- State class was replaced by PipelineStateManager
- Change SamplerUniform binding system
- Added Framebuffer.bindRead and Framebuffer.bindWrite
- Added Framebuffer.blit
- Fixed creation FramebufferImpl without stencil
- Added CometRenderer.enableDepthTest and CometRenderer.disableDepthTest
- Included GLTextureUtils library
- Deleted CometLoaders class
- Inverted shader builder creation: loader.createShaderBuilder() -> GLShader.builder(loader)
- Invert shader builder creation: loader.createShaderBuilder() -> GLShader.builder(loader)
- Invert GLSLFileEntry creation: loader.createGLSLFileEntry(...) -> GLSLFileEntry.load(...)
- Renamed CometLoader to GLSLLoader
- Moved stencil classes in 'stencil' package
- Moved some classes
- Refactored registry system
- Removed applying uncompiled shaders in GLProgramBuilder
- Changed program and shader compiling process
- Recoded exception handling

## 'glfw' plugin
- Added

## 'better-exceptions' plugin
- Removed

## 'better-compiler' plugin
- Renamed GlShaderLibraryBuilder to GLShaderLibraryBuilder

## CRM
- Fixed incompatibility with Iris Shders for version 1.21.5+
- Merged MinecraftBufferRenderer, MinecraftBufferUniformUploaders and MinecraftSamplerUniformUploaders into MinecraftEXT

releases.notes:
# Changelog

## CRM
- Added ``CRMInstance.getScaledMousePos()`` method
- Fixed comet framebuffers binding in 1.21.4 version
- Ported to 26.1.2
- Fixed a bug where CometRenderer binding conflicts with Minecraft programs could occur
- Added liquid glass program and batch
- TTFFont creation changes

## Main
- Added State.FRAMEBUFFER
- Added State.STENCIL
- Added State.COLOR_MASK
- Added State.PROGRAM
- Added stencil system
- GL capability check changes
- Updated gl-texture-utils implementation to 1.7.6
- Added optimizations using the ``ARB_direct_state_access`` and ``ARB_buffer_storage`` extensions

## Plugin 'better-compiler'
- Fixed #include & #constant bugs

## Changes:
- UniformType.MATRIX has been renamed to UniformType.MATRIX4.
- Added Tag registry system.
- Added Compiler extensions (plugins) system.
- Added config system.
- post-effects have been moved to a separate plugin ('post-effects').
- Added global registry that stores both persistent and volatile data.
- Exception output with detailed descriptions, a list of possible problems and solutions has been moved to the 'better-exceptions' plugin.
- shader libraries have been moved to a separate plugin ('shader-libraries').
- Some refactors.
